name: sourced_20261022
decision: Seongho, 2026-10-22 and 2026-10-28: SUS304 on both surfaces; only published measured parameters; this set is the default for all contact runs.

sources.asperity_gt_k: 0.001 (range 0.001-0.002): Sander et al., Tribol. Int. 2016, doi:10.1016/j.triboint.2015.12.024, Table 5 (measured on a journal-bearing shell and shaft, new and worn).
sources.boundary_friction_coefficient: 0.07 (range 0.05-0.07): Matsumoto, Kaneko, Kawaguchi, Purdue IRACC 2016 paper 1764, Fig. 7(a), Idemitsu PVE oils with R410A/R32.
sources.contact_modulus: E* = 110 GPa: SUS304 on SUS304, E = 200 GPa, nu = 0.30 (Rolled Alloys 304/304L datasheet); 1/E* = sum (1 - nu^2)/E.
sources.roughness: Composite sigma 0.4 um (upper 0.5 um), split equally (Rq = sigma/sqrt 2 each, so phi_s = Phi_fs = 0). Project estimate from drawing Rz 1.6 um and cylindricity; NOT measured.
sources.tilt_slope_y: 0.416 mrad in the load plane from the tolerance stack (Seongho); NOT measured.
sources.flow_factor_model: Patir-Cheng as in the 2026-10-23 A/B check; with equal roughness only phi_x, phi_f and phi_fp act.
